bio_en: Gaspar Hakobian, photographed beside Samson (Stepan Tadevosian), took up the ARF's work in Atrpatakan in the late 1890s, when the Armenakan and Hnchak parties had faded and the active elements had withdrawn to the Caucasus after the 1897 Khanasor action. He rebuilt the party's networks in the region in the years that followed.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: low. Text truncated; not the same as Gaspar Ipekian (#236).
